text:
Düsseldorf’s median asking rent stands at 14.45 €/m², up 4.1 % year‑on‑year and 29.6 % over the last five years, placing the city eighth among the 37 most expensive German markets. The market remains balanced, with a vacancy rate of 1.6 % and an average of 26 days on market; 29 % of listings are let within a week.

Affordability is tight: the median asking rent is 56 % above the 2022 census existing rent of 9.24 €/m², while a 60 m² unit costs about 867 € per month and the rent‑burden for two residents is 16 %.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 15.32 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 14.91 €/m² and 15.55 €/m², reflecting a further 6 % rise.
